decisions.executionNote: Begin continuous elbow-up approach, pitching both grippers downward. Left approaches front pepper; right approaches the rightmost watch, with height and tool offset still uncertain.
Retry with halved pose increments after zero-motion IK rejection, preserving the initial branch.
Finish downward orientation while moving above front red pepper and right watch; keep grippers open and remain above the table.
Replan from actual poses with slower rotation and clearance lift; RGB suggests a higher tabletop and incidental contact, so refine object alignment before descending.
Short vertical descent to grasp the front red pepper and right watch, then close. Grasp retention will be checked by lifting and RGB, not gripper command state.
Allow closure and lift vertically to test retention. Descent showed contact residuals, so do not push farther into the surface.
Left pepper is visibly retained: carry it above the middle basket. Right watch stayed on the table; reopen and correct forward alignment for another grasp.
Use smaller left transport increments after continuity rejection, stopping over the near half of the middle basket. Refine the right watch approach and close again.
Lower slightly to regain reach margin while moving the retained pepper inside the middle basket, then release. Right attempts closure in place near the watch without further downward pressure.
Pepper visibly landed in front of blue basket, not inside. Regrasp it; move right jaws forward to the watch. Account for the jaw center offset behind link6.
Correct invalid row; no preceding motion occurred. Withdraw open jaws from basket lips to realign with the objects on the tabletop.
Close around the wrist-centered left pepper and lift for retention check. Nudge right toward the visible watch, descend only a little, and close.
Both previous closures missed. Move left contact region forward and down around pepper; reopen and reposition right above the watch using wrist alignment.
Lift both closed grippers to check retention and clear basket contact. Left pepper appears between jaws; right watch grasp remains uncertain.
RGB shows empty jaws: prior grasps were too high. Approach lower with left aligned to the pepper; pitch right slightly forward to reach the watch without its body pressing the basket lip.
Replan from contact-limited poses: retreat from basket walls while lowering gradually and shifting the right jaws left over the watch.
Descend vertically at the clearer, rearward alignment and close around the pepper and watch near tabletop grasp height.
Lift vertically with closed jaws to verify the lower-height grasps and clear the basket rims before transport.
Carry visibly retained pepper forward toward blue basket, tilting forward for reach margin. Right retries the watch after correcting its lateral alignment, keeping arms separate.
Forward transport contacted the basket; lift the pepper higher while backing slightly away. Right aligns laterally at the watch and closes from behind the rim.
Use a small orientation bridge toward the last accepted target before withdrawing upward, to satisfy continuity with both observed and preceding IK configurations.
The pepper dropped after rim contact. Reapproach its new position with open jaws. Lift the right closed gripper away from the rim to test watch retention.
Lower left jaws around the centered pepper and close. Right watch is still on table: approach farther forward and lower, monitoring rim contact.
Lift the left grasp well above rim level without rotating. Withdraw right from persistent basket contact to choose a clearer approach.
Return left toward the previously effective downward grasp orientation and height at the moved pepper. Right leaves the rim-obstructed watch and approaches the unobstructed central watch.
Close left at the successful grasp height and begin a straight lift. Center and lower the right gripper over the unobstructed pale watch, staying on the right side.
Lift left pepper vertically to full rim clearance before any forward motion. Adjust right slightly left and back to center the watch between jaw contact regions, then close.
Transport the retained pepper above the blue rim with a gradual forward tilt, maintaining clearance. Lift and withdraw the central watch grasp toward a clear staging area.
Move the pepper farther inside the middle basket and release from rim-clearing height. Right watch was not retained; approach its moved, unobstructed position at a lower grasp height.
Release pepper at the current visibly interior blue-basket position, then retreat from the reach limit. Lower right jaws around the centered pale watch and close.
Pepper is visibly released into blue. Retreat left with smaller initial increments after the near-limit rejection. Finish lowering the right watch grasp and close.
Move left within its workspace toward the green pepper, restoring a near-downward grasp attitude. Lift right to check whether the watch strap is retained.
Center green pepper laterally and move both contact regions rearward based on wrist views, then close near tabletop height. Right aims to pinch the watch strap rather than close above it.
Lift right to test the centered watch grasp. Green pepper shifted forward on the table; reopen and follow its new position before closing.
Both objects appear retained. Lift green pepper to rim-clearing height. Stage the pale watch at the central front tabletop for later left-arm pickup, without crossing arms.
Carry green pepper across the left workspace at clearance height toward blue. Withdraw right from the staged watch and approach the remaining black watch from behind its basket lip.
Bring green pepper over blue with the gradual forward-tilted transfer used for the red pepper. Approach the black watch at the lower successful watch-grasp height.
Release green pepper farther inside blue basket. Close around the black watch at near-table height and begin a small verification lift.
Withdraw left clear of the basket before descending toward the last red pepper. Lift right closed jaws to verify black-watch retention.
Replan left from the rim-limited pose with smaller retreat and attitude increments. Black watch remains on table; move right's contact region rearward as for the successful pale-watch grasp.
Correct malformed row; previous request executed nothing. Close left around the last pepper and angle the right tool forward toward the watch while maintaining wrist clearance.
Lift the last pepper vertically. Lower the forward-angled right jaws slightly around the centered black watch, close, and begin lifting to verify retention.
Carry the retained final pepper toward blue with rim clearance. Right closure missed above the watch; reopen and lower the angled grasp with a small rearward correction.
Release the final pepper well inside the middle basket. Keep the right gripper closed and lift to verify the lower angled watch grasp.
All peppers appear in blue. Retreat left toward the staged pale watch. Right watch is still unretained; lower the angled approach to compensate for its shorter vertical finger reach.
Close the lower right grasp and lift without pushing farther into contact. Left approaches the staged watch from its side of the centerline, then closes at tabletop grasp height.
Lift left to identify what is retained before any basket transfer; chocolate may have been disturbed. Recenter right leftward over the rolled black watch and approach its lower angled grasp height.
Right watch is centered between the lower angled jaws; close and lift. Left isolates the adjacent purple chocolate for central staging rather than risk mixing it with the watch.
Black watch now appears retained; transport it toward a central staging point. Lift and move the left grasp away to distinguish retention and keep the tools separated.
Stage the retained black watch at the central front table for left-arm access. Left grasp was empty; move left aside to maintain tool separation during release.
Withdraw right after staging, leaving the central objects accessible. Approach the pale watch with left while keeping its end effector on the left side and avoiding the neighboring chocolate.
Center the pale watch in the left jaw contact region and close at the established near-table height. Hold right clear to avoid interfering with adjacent watches.
Lift and carry the left watch grasp away from the center for retention check. Approach purple chocolate with right only after the tools separate laterally.

Left watch slipped: retry at a more vertical attitude and slightly rearward contact region. Right centers and closes around purple chocolate at a lower height, with both tools remaining on their own sides.
Tools contacted near the center; retreat left upward and leftward from the observed pose and keep it parked clear. Close right in place before judging chocolate retention.
Keep left parked clear. Reopen right, align rearward and slightly toward the center over the purple bar, then close at the lower grasp height.
Lift and move the purple chocolate grasp into the right workspace. Approach the pale watch with left as the tools remain laterally separated, aiming farther behind its ring for a secure pinch.
Recenter and lower left around the pale watch. Purple chocolate fell into the right workspace; approach it again while rotating the jaws to pinch across the bar rather than its end.
Allow the left watch closure to settle, then lift vertically. Move right's rotated contact region rearward over the purple bar and close without further table pressure.
Both objects appear between the jaws. Lift and separate the tools into their respective workspaces without rotation, checking retention before basket transport.
Carry the visibly retained pale watch toward the left basket at rim-clearing height. Purple chocolate slipped again; reapproach its new right-side position farther behind its center.
Release the pale watch safely inside the left basket. Correct right laterally and rearward in its rotated wrist view, lower to the chocolate's side faces, then close.
Pale watch is in white basket. Left retreats and approaches the staged black watch with a downward attitude. Lift right's closed chocolate grasp while separating laterally to test retention.
Approach the staged black watch from the left side. Purple bar slipped and changed orientation; reopen and approach its newly observed position in the right workspace.
Close left around the staged black watch. Right bar is ahead and right of the current contact region in wrist RGB; move toward it at fixed height before closing.
Let both closures settle, then lift vertically without rotation to assess whether the watch and purple chocolate remain between the jaws.
Carry the retained black watch toward the left basket with additional clearance. Right missed the bar's center; advance its contact line slightly and descend for a centered pinch.
Carry the black watch over the left basket with gradual forward tilt and rim clearance. Lift the right chocolate grasp vertically to check retention without sideways drag.
Release the second watch inside white. Reorient right jaws across the now lengthwise purple bar and approach nearly vertically, using its head-camera position rather than the prior slipped grasp.
Watches are visibly in white and peppers in blue. Grasp the now-centered purple bar with right and begin a test lift; left approaches the red-wrapped chocolate for eventual central staging.
Align the jaw contact lines nearer the centers of both thin bars, slightly rearward and lower than the unsuccessful end pinches, then close and settle.
Slow straight lifts with both jaws held closed to test the centered chocolate grasps before any horizontal transport.
Purple bar is visibly retained; lift it to rim clearance without changing attitude. Recenter left toward the red bar's moved body rather than its narrow wrapper end, then close.
Transport retained purple chocolate toward the right basket, preserving clearance while tilting forward gradually. Lift the left red-bar grasp straight up for retention assessment.
Release purple chocolate inside the right basket. Reapproach the red bar at its newly rotated center, shifting the left contact region rearward and right before closing.
Let the red-bar grasp settle, then lift slowly to verify retention. Withdraw right from the completed basket placement and restore its grasping attitude for the final relay.
Red bar is retained. Carry it toward a central tabletop staging area while keeping left on its own side and right parked clear for the subsequent pickup.
Stage the final red bar near the centerline for the right arm, using a small inward tool tilt while the left link6 remains on its own side. Keep right parked until release is observed.
Final bar is now staged in the right workspace. Withdraw and begin resetting left along a continuous path while right approaches the bar with open jaws, preserving lateral separation.
Continue the left arm's gradual return toward origin. Center right on the red bar's body, descend to the previously successful thin-bar height, and close.
